inputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Options provide shared device-session settings, the current host and approved-device lookup, and packet send/drop callbacks. The callback members cannot be represented in JSON, so this input has no JSON example.

inputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.connected.deviceId
inputs.description: Remote host device ID used to find the session entry whose live link determines connectivity. An unknown or detached entry produces false.

inputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.packet.address
inputs.description: Address containing the remote device ID and connection ID used to select the current session connection. A nonmatching connection is not treated as the current connection for sealed packets.

inputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.packet.packet
inputs.description: Secure packet received for the device connection: hello packets begin or replace a connection, and sealed packets are opened on the matching current connection. Other packet types are dropped as protocol violations.

inputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.close.address
inputs.description: Address used to find the session entry to detach. The entry is detached only when both its device ID and current connection ID match.

inputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.revoke.deviceId
inputs.description: Remote host device ID whose session should end. If no entry exists, revocation is a no-op; otherwise the entry is removed, detached, and ended.

inputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.announce.channel
inputs.description: Wire event channel that selects the event category emitted to connected device sessions. The service emits only to entries with a live link and does not retain events for detached sessions.

inputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.announce.value
inputs.description: Opaque event payload passed to each connected session wire emitter with the selected channel. The service does not retain it for entries without a live link.

inputs.name: phoneTrackerPull.scopeParts
inputs.description: The authenticated host ID, phone device ID and pairing generation. The adapter derives the Tracker cursor scope from these values.

inputs.name: phoneTrackerPull.fetcher
inputs.description: The injected HTTP function that reads the Tracker native hub on loopback.

inputs.name: phoneTrackerPush.scopeParts
inputs.description: The authenticated host ID, phone ID and pairing generation used to derive the write scope.

inputs.name: phoneTrackerPush.grant
inputs.description: The approved phone ID and private loopback bearer configured on the desktop.

inputs.name: phoneTrackerPush.fetcher
inputs.description: The HTTP function used to post the validated device request to the hub.

outputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.connected
outputs.description: Whether the requested device entry currently has a live wire link. It is false when the entry is absent or detached.

outputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.packet
outputs.description: Promise that completes asynchronous packet handling with no fulfillment value. Hello packets perform the secure handshake; sealed packets are opened and delivered when their plaintext is non-null, while invalid or noncurrent packets are dropped.

outputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.close
outputs.description: No value is returned. A matching current connection is detached; an absent entry or stale connection address has no effect.

outputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.revoke
outputs.description: No value is returned. The selected device entry is removed and its session is ended; an unknown device ID has no effect.

outputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.detachAll
outputs.description: No value is returned. Every current connection is detached while its device session entry remains available for a later connection.

outputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.announce
outputs.description: No value is returned. The value is emitted on the requested channel to each entry with a live link and is not queued for other entries.

outputs.name: RemoteDeviceSessionsService.end
outputs.description: No value is returned. Every device currently in the entry map is revoked, detached, and ended.

outputs.name: phoneTrackerPull
outputs.description: Returns an async reader for the bound device scope. The reader accepts version 1 and at most one cursor or continuation, and resolves to the hub's decoded JSON response of at most 128 KiB.

errors.name: invalidTrackerPull
errors.description: An unsupported version, malformed position, failed HTTP response, missing body or oversized response rejects the pull with the corresponding remote failure code.

errors.name: invalidProjectionJson
errors.description: The hub response body could not be parsed as JSON.

errors.name: trackerPullTransport
errors.description: The default fetch or response stream rejects on transport failure, an unreadable body or the eight-second request timeout.

errors.name: remotePushRefused
errors.description: The sender rejects a refused, malformed, oversized or unavailable loopback response.

errors.name: trackerPushTransport
errors.description: A fetch or stream error, session revocation or request timeout rejects the sender.

errors.name: trackerPushJson
errors.description: The response body could not be decoded as JSON.
